WoW: Forever

Restoration Shaman

Healer with one big single-target heal, a chain heal across a group, and from 40 an instant heal over time on a 12-second cooldown. WoW: Forever · Healer · Updated November 13, 2026 · Client build 1.60.1.70938 · Null Ossuary

Guide to the live game, 1 to 60. Spell and talent figures come from Blizzard's posts and the client with its hotfixes. Talent builds are the guide sites' own, named and dated November 4; the Restoration tree has not changed since. If cast on a party member, the heal will only jump to other party members. Each jump is 50% as effective as the previous target. Heals 3 total targets. and RiptideRiptideLevel 40 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost150 ManaRange40 yd rangeCooldown12 sec cooldownDuration15 secHeals a friendly target for 445 over 15 sec, and increases the effectiveness of your Chain Heal casts directly on that target by 25%. both arrive at level 40, so you heal the first thirty levels of dungeons with Healing WaveHealing WaveLevel 1 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 10Cast1.5 sec castCost25 ManaRange40 yd rangeHeals a friendly target for 37 to 47.. Nothing here rests on a raid log: no raid opens until December 9. Talent levels assume no TalentedTalentedTalentCastInstantYou gain talent points every level starting at level 5 instead of starting at level 10, but you still may not have more than 51 total talent points. Legacy perk, which starts your points up to five levels earlier without raising the 51-point cap. Spell tooltips read the base game client and can lag a hotfix, so where one differs from the text here, trust the text.

What Restoration is for

Group healing that is not limited by cooldowns. Healing WaveHealing WaveLevel 1 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 10Cast1.5 sec castCost25 ManaRange40 yd rangeHeals a friendly target for 37 to 47. is the single-target heal from level 1. Chain HealChain HealLevel 40 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 3Cast2.5 sec castCost260 ManaRange40 yd rangeHeals the friendly target for 246 to 281, then jumps to heal additional nearby targets. If cast on a party member, the heal will only jump to other party members. Each jump is 50% as effective as the previous target. Heals 3 total targets. at 40 heals three targets, each jump half as strong as the last. RiptideRiptideLevel 40 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost150 ManaRange40 yd rangeCooldown12 sec cooldownDuration15 secHeals a friendly target for 445 over 15 sec, and increases the effectiveness of your Chain Heal casts directly on that target by 25%. at 40 is an instant heal over 15 seconds, and a Chain Heal cast directly on the Riptide target is 25% stronger.

It is a group spec, and both sites say so. Icy Veins: "As a Healer specialization, Restoration lacks most of the damage talent support of other classes and has no area damage, making it more of a group leveling specialization." Wowhead: "Overall, you should look to play Enhancement instead if you are solo leveling for the most part." Icy Veins rates it 4.5 of 5 overall, 4.5 for dungeons, 5 for utility and 2 for levelling; a levelling score measures solo kill speed.

Before 40 the group tools are totems and Mana. Water ShieldWater ShieldLevel 20 · Spell · NatureCastInstantDuration600 secThe caster is surrounded by 3 globes of water. When a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's spells gets a critical result, 2% of maximum mana is restored to the caster, expending one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds. Lasts 600 sec. Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time. at exactly 20 returns 2% of your maximum Mana when you are hit or land any spell crit. Mana Tide TotemMana Tide TotemLevel 1 · Spell · Frost · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost10 ManaCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration13 secSummons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec that restores 88 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards. at 25 restores Mana to the group. Nature's SwiftnessNature's SwiftnessTalentCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledWhen activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell. at 30 makes your next Nature spell instant, in practice a Healing WaveHealing WaveLevel 1 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 10Cast1.5 sec castCost25 ManaRange40 yd rangeHeals a friendly target for 37 to 47. you cannot be interrupted out of.

If you solo as Restoration, you play a weaker Elemental. Wowhead's levelling list for the spec is a weapon imbue, a shield, Searing TotemSearing TotemLevel 10 · Spell · Fire · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost25 ManaDuration30 secSummons a Searing Totem with 5 health at your feet for 30 sec that repeatedly attacks an enemy within 20 yards for 9 to 11 Fire damage. and Lightning BoltLightning BoltLevel 1 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 10Cast1.5 sec castCost15 ManaRange30 yd rangeCasts a bolt of lightning at the target for 15 to 18 Nature damage., with Fire NovaFire NovaLevel 12 · Spell · Fire · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost65 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldownInstantly inflicts 32 to 38 fire damage to enemies within 10 yd of your active Fire totem. on packs.

Why this order.

  • Downranking is the Mana tool. Wowhead: "The healing difference between ranks in WoW: Forever is far lower than in Vanilla WoW, meaning you're more incentivized to downrank to save on Mana." Icy Veins' lists say the same of Healing WaveHealing WaveLevel 1 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 10Cast1.5 sec castCost25 ManaRange40 yd rangeHeals a friendly target for 37 to 47. and Chain HealChain HealLevel 40 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 3Cast2.5 sec castCost260 ManaRange40 yd rangeHeals the friendly target for 246 to 281, then jumps to heal additional nearby targets. If cast on a party member, the heal will only jump to other party members. Each jump is 50% as effective as the previous target. Heals 3 total targets.. One creator healing levelling dungeons keeps the top rank and one two or three ranks lower on the bars, and treats Lesser Healing WaveLesser Healing WaveLevel 20 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 6Cast1.5 sec castCost105 ManaRange40 yd rangeHeals a friendly target for 151 to 172. as an emergency button only; that is one player's method.
  • Low ranks of Healing WaveHealing WaveLevel 1 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 10Cast1.5 sec castCost25 ManaRange40 yd rangeHeals a friendly target for 37 to 47. are also fast. Rank 1 casts in 1.5 seconds, rank 2 in 2.0, rank 3 in 2.5 and rank 4 up in 3.0, before Improved Healing WaveImproved Healing WaveTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantReduces the casting time of your Healing Wave spell by 0.5 sec.. Rank 2 costs 45 Mana.
  • RiptideRiptideLevel 40 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost150 ManaRange40 yd rangeCooldown12 sec cooldownDuration15 secHeals a friendly target for 445 over 15 sec, and increases the effectiveness of your Chain Heal casts directly on that target by 25%. first, because it sets up Chain HealChain HealLevel 40 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 3Cast2.5 sec castCost260 ManaRange40 yd rangeHeals the friendly target for 246 to 281, then jumps to heal additional nearby targets. If cast on a party member, the heal will only jump to other party members. Each jump is 50% as effective as the previous target. Heals 3 total targets.. The 25% bonus applies to a Chain Heal cast directly on the Riptide target. Rank 1 heals 445 over 15 seconds for 150 Mana on a 12-second cooldown, so it can sit on one target at all times.
  • Chain HealChain HealLevel 40 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 3Cast2.5 sec castCost260 ManaRange40 yd rangeHeals the friendly target for 246 to 281, then jumps to heal additional nearby targets. If cast on a party member, the heal will only jump to other party members. Each jump is 50% as effective as the previous target. Heals 3 total targets. costs more than it looks on one target. Rank 1 heals 246 to 281 for 260 Mana on a 2.5-second cast; the value is in the two jumps.
  • Wait before you heal when you can. Spirit regeneration stops for 5 seconds after any spell that costs Mana. Wowhead's advice is one full-rank Healing WaveHealing WaveLevel 1 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 10Cast1.5 sec castCost25 ManaRange40 yd rangeHeals a friendly target for 37 to 47. on a deeply injured target rather than several small ones, to spend more time outside that window.
  • Water ShieldWater ShieldLevel 20 · Spell · NatureCastInstantDuration600 secThe caster is surrounded by 3 globes of water. When a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's spells gets a critical result, 2% of maximum mana is restored to the caster, expending one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds. Lasts 600 sec. Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time. has three globes. Each returns 2% of maximum Mana, and the tooltip says only one fires every few seconds. Recast it when the globes are gone.

Stat priority

The two guide sites nearly agree.

Wowhead, dated November 1:

  1. Spell Healing
  2. Critical strike
  3. Haste
  4. Intellect
  5. Spirit
  6. MP5

Icy Veins, dated November 4:

  1. Healing Power
  2. Critical strike
  3. Intellect
  4. Spirit
  5. MP5

The only difference is Haste, which Icy Veins does not list. Both put critical strike second for the same reason: a crit triggers Water ShieldWater ShieldLevel 20 · Spell · NatureCastInstantDuration600 secThe caster is surrounded by 3 globes of water. When a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's spells gets a critical result, 2% of maximum mana is restored to the caster, expending one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds. Lasts 600 sec. Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time. and Ancestral HealingAncestral HealingTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantIncreases your target's armor value by 25% for 15 sec after getting a critical effect from one of your healing spells., so it returns Mana and puts an armor buff on the target.

While levelling, Wowhead adds Spell Damage, Hit and Spell Piercing for the damage you do between heals.
